name: Surrogate Gradient Method
definition: A method to optimize spiking neural networks end-to-end by approximating the derivative of the non-differentiable Heaviside step function used in spike firing.
summary: The Surrogate Gradient Method optimizes non-differentiable systems by replacing undefined derivatives with differentiable approximations during back-propagation, differing from exact methods by introducing gradient bias to enable end-to-end training.
